item.name: Create disposable order - server total 24 and Pending

exec: pm.test('HTTP 200 preserves omitted fields', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const order = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(order.total).to.eql(32); pm.expect(order.customerName).to.eql('Postman Demo'); });

item.name: Reject negative quantity without partial change
Ignore client id and total on PATCH

exec: pm.test('Server still owns ID and total', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const order = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(order.id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('orderId')); pm.expect(order.total).to.eql(32); });
pm.test('HTTP 400 malformed JSON', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(400); pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.include('Malformed JSON'); });
pm.test('HTTP 204 no body', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(204); pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.eql(''); });
